about_blocks.text: About Twelve Mile Recovery at Rodman Hall
about_blocks.html: About Twelve Mile Recovery at Rodman Hall

about_blocks.text: Twelve Mile Recovery at Rodman Hall is a private residential addiction treatment program in a restored stone estate at 109 St Paul Crescent in St. Catharines, Ontario. The house sits on wooded grounds above Twelve Mile Creek, close to downtown but screened by trees, with paths and stairs leading down toward the water.
about_blocks.html: Twelve Mile Recovery at Rodman Hall is a private residential addiction treatment program in a restored stone estate at 109 St Paul Crescent in St. Catharines, Ontario. The house sits on wooded grounds above Twelve Mile Creek, close to downtown but screened by trees, with paths and stairs leading down toward the water.

about_blocks.text: The house has a long local history. Thomas Rodman Merritt built it between about 1857 and 1863, and from 1960 it was a public art gallery, run by Brock University from 2003. Today the old rooms are used for treatment and daily life. There are drawing rooms with marble fireplaces, a piano room, a large lounge with a putting green and games table, and a dining hall where everyone eats together under a stained-glass ceiling. Bedrooms are single or shared, and many have a fireplace, a bay window or an ensuite bathroom.

about_blocks.text: Rodman Hall used to run as Freeport Recovery. In June 2026 Freeport Recovery Group signed an operating agreement with Twelve Mile Recovery, and the estate took the Twelve Mile name. Twelve Mile's clinical leadership directs the program, and both Twelve Mile houses hold CARF accreditation.

about_blocks.text: Residential stays run six, nine or twelve weeks. Days start with movement and meditation, then move into one-to-one therapy with a master's-level therapist and small groups. Afternoons are for martial arts, yoga, breathwork and skills work in the estate's studio and gym, which has a cedar sauna and a red-light room next door. Every client has a pharmacogenetic test so the physicians can make better prescribing choices from the start.

about_blocks.text: Rodman Hall does not do detox. The centre asks for at least 72 hours of sobriety before you arrive and can refer you to a withdrawal management service first. After residence you get six weeks of virtual reintegration with the same counsellor, then lifetime alumni aftercare through the centre's app.

centre.faq_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Twelve Mile Recovery at Rodman Hall

faqs.question: How much does Twelve Mile Recovery at Rodman Hall cost?

answer_blocks.text: recovery.com lists an estimate of $27,000 CAD for the full program at Rodman Hall, which covers six weeks of residential treatment and six weeks of virtual care. Twelve Mile's own FAQ gives a range of $20,000 to $30,000 for a six-week stay, depending on program, length of stay and room. Admissions confirms the exact fee on the first call.

faqs.question: Where is Rodman Hall and how do I get there?

answer_blocks.text: Rodman Hall is at 109 St Paul Crescent in St. Catharines, in Ontario's Niagara Region, on the wooded bank of Twelve Mile Creek. It is about an hour and a quarter from Toronto by the QEW, about 45 minutes from Hamilton and around 20 minutes from Niagara Falls. Call admissions before you travel so they can plan your arrival.

faqs.question: How is Rodman Hall different from Twelve Mile Recovery on Lake Street?

answer_blocks.text: Both houses belong to the same program. Rodman Hall is the large heritage estate on Twelve Mile Creek, with gardens, woodland trails, a gym, a studio, a sauna and a red-light room. Twelve Mile Recovery on Lake Street is a smaller renovated house in downtown St. Catharines that the centre calls its most affordable six-week option. We list them separately as Twelve Mile Recovery at Rodman Hall and Twelve Mile Recovery.

answer_blocks.text: Yes. The estate operated as Freeport Recovery until June 2026, when Freeport Recovery Group signed an operating agreement with Twelve Mile Recovery and the site was renamed Twelve Mile Recovery at Rodman Hall. The old freeportrecovery.ca address now forwards to twelvemilerecovery.ca.

faqs.question: What happens after I leave Rodman Hall?

answer_blocks.text: You move into six weeks of virtual reintegration with the counsellor you had in residence, at no extra cost. After that you become an alumni member for life, with group and one-to-one sessions through the centre's private app, which also has a space for families.

faqs.question: Is Rodman Hall private? Can I use my benefits?

answer_blocks.text: Yes, it is a private, fee-based centre, so OHIP does not usually cover it. Twelve Mile does not bill insurers directly, but it provides detailed receipts you can submit to an extended health or employer plan. Financing is available through Medicard by iFinance.

answer_blocks.text: The program treats alcohol and drug addiction, including opioids and fentanyl, cocaine, methamphetamine, benzodiazepines, prescription drugs and cannabis, as well as gambling. Mental health concerns that come with addiction, such as anxiety, depression and trauma, are treated alongside it.

faqs.question: What are the bedrooms like at Rodman Hall?

answer_blocks.text: Rodman Hall has single rooms and shared rooms for two. Many of them have a marble fireplace, bay windows or an ensuite bathroom, and the centre's tour shows them furnished with desks and armchairs.

faqs.question: Can my family visit during treatment?

answer_blocks.text: Yes, when it is clinically appropriate. Twelve Mile supports family visits that fit the treatment plan and runs family therapy and education, and families keep their own space in the alumni app after discharge.
